title: An international consulting hub for entering Belarus and the EAEU
lead: We build working connections between Italian manufacturing and the Belarusian market. Official status, an international team and end-to-end support.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: We create a predictable and safe path for Italian businesses into Belarus and the Eurasian Economic Union. We are more than consultants: we are a strategic bridge connecting markets, cultures, people and opportunities.

people.name: Mario Ubaldi
people.about: Italian business consultant with 20 years of experience. He specialises in financing, grants and the internationalisation of Italian companies, with a broad client base of manufacturers across different sectors. He speaks Italian, English, French and Portuguese.

people.name: Viktoria Gubanova
people.about: Belarusian. Former director of Planix Group in Belarus and official representative of the Finnish company Planix. She worked on importing large-format equipment and systematically connecting Belarusian and Finnish businesses: finding Belarusian partners at the request of Finnish companies, organising exhibitions and seminars in Finland, and working with the Finnish embassy. She now focuses on the Italian market.

status.title: Our status and partners
status.text: Official representatives of the National Agency of Investment and Privatization of the Republic of Belarus (NAIP) in Italy.
status.listTitle: This gives us direct access to:
items: Belarusian businesses and their actual needs
information on preferential regimes, incentives and government support
opportunities to arrange meetings with government bodies
status.retail: Our strategic retail market-entry partner is SDELKI V PLUS LLC, a trade agency with established relationships with more than 20 retail chains and 60 wholesale buyers in Russia and Belarus.

items.title: Official status
items.text: NAIP representatives in Italy, with direct access to government support.

items.title: Three languages
items.text: We work in Russian, Italian and English.

items.title: Two markets, one team
items.text: We live and work in Italy and Belarus, and understand both sides.

items.title: End-to-end support
items.text: From market research to supplying retail chains, with a single team.

items.title: Checks before introductions
items.text: We check counterparties for reliability and sanctions risks before you invest time in a meeting.

items.title: A network of vetted specialists
items.text: Accountants, interpreters and other specialists are available on request.
